finding: the containment guarantee is a property of exact evidence: under noise the estimate turns pessimistic (4/20 at sigma 0.3, 14/20 at sigma 1.0). A quantile bound softens it (14 -> 11) and a spread threshold only withholds reports without making them honest (5/9 contained). Mean error is non-monotone because the one-step quantisation dominates; the tail is where the noise shows.
headroom: first measured headroom in the program: at sigma 1.0 the deterministic estimator is pessimistic in 70% of realizations, so it is not at ceiling and mission P1 section 4 licenses a learned arm. omo is reachable (ports 22/11434 open; Ollama by IP, non-interactive ssh hangs at the Tailscale handshake).
